name: Thai Film Industries Public Company Limited
summary: Thai Film Industries Public Company Limited manufactures and sells packaging films in Thailand, Asia, Europe, the United States, and internationally. It offers BOPP, CPP, PET, and metalized films for use in printing, lamination, and adhesive tapes. The company was formerly known as TFI Corporation Public Company Limited and changed its name to Thai Film Industries Public Company Limited in July 2012. Thai Film Industries Public Company Limited was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Bang Phli, Thailand.
